verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents building custom modules for business-specific data. Its Modules API lists custom and linking (MxN) modules, and its metadata API covers modules, fields, and related lists. This shows custom objects with relationships exist, but the evidence does not document how a developer defines custom fields or relationship types (lookups, MxN) on those modules. missing for 10: documentation of creating and configuring custom fields on custom modules, explicit relationship/lookup modeling between custom objects, API or developer-side creation of custom modules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
